advisory_snapshot.provenance: Human-reviewed, minimal npm advisory snapshot for governed root overrides. The immutable SHA-256 above binds this record to the separately checked-in advisory content, so verify is deterministic and network-free; refresh both deliberately when an override or advisory changes.

scope.npm: All root package.json overrides are governed. Each must have a matching npm_overrides record with a rationale and a complete per-pin advisory_ids mapping. R2 deliberately fails closed for any live override: npm's lockfile records the override result, not a mechanically reproducible no-override resolution.
scope.cargo: This checker admits three Cargo mechanisms: the root candle-kernels Git patch at the Candle fork's 0.11.0 publication commit, the exact local libsqlite3-sys 0.38.1 with the SQLite Windows WAL path backport and per-connection page caches, and the exact crates.io registry pins of FathomDB's fork crates (cargo_fork_registry_pins: cudarc-fathomdb, reached only through Candle, and the Candle fork crates the embedder pins exactly). It authenticates the patch sources, the local crate's version, license, Cargo.lock package source and vendored tree digest (plus the amended SQLite amalgamation digest), the manifest form of each fork pin, and that Cargo.lock holds each fork crate exactly once from crates.io with its published checksum. Any other [patch], [replace], or direct Git dependency hard-fails as unsupported. Root .cargo/config.toml and .cargo/config reject patch tables and unparseable candidates. The local patches affect workspace builds; they do not propagate through a published Rust crate.
scope.governed_commit_pins: scripts/governed-surface-pin.json pins repository contract content, not an external dependency version. Its commit/hash integrity is enforced by scripts/check-governed-surface-pin.sh; it has no package-advisory semantics and is explicitly not reinterpreted here.

cargo_candle_exception.rationale: The candle-kernels patch exists only to carry the Candle fork's statically linked CUDA runtime (fork items K4 and K6) into FathomDB-built artifacts, so CPU-mode distributable artifacts can map without libcuda.so.1 or libcudart while CUDA driver discovery stays dynamic (REQ-068, REQ31-16, owner ruling Q2). crates.io publishes candle-kernels 0.10.2 with dynamic libcudart; this immutable revision is the commit the Candle fork crates 0.11.0 were published from (182ceab0), whose candle-kernels tree equals the qualified 853324fc. The Candle fork crates themselves come from crates.io (cargo_fork_registry_pins).

advisory_posture.scope: outside the checked-in npm advisory snapshot
advisory_posture.rationale: This is not a claim that the external Rust source has or lacks a vulnerability. The checked-in GitHub advisory snapshot covers only governed npm overrides; any revision change requires a fresh human advisory review.

cargo_sqlite_exception.rationale: SQLite 3.53.2 misclassifies Win32 long DOS-device local-drive paths as UNC and can strand WAL read locks. This exact local crate preserves the published 0.38.1 package and bundled SQLite 3.53.2, backporting the upstream 3.53.3 winIsUNCPath correction and adding a Windows-only compile-option marker. The marker lets published Rust-crate consumers of unpatched SQLite refuse unsafe local verbatim paths before database creation because root patches do not propagate. Its build script also omits SQLITE_ENABLE_MEMORY_MANAGEMENT, so each SQLite connection keeps its own page cache (0.8.28 Slice 40 Unit I); rusqlite removed that flag upstream in commit f31f7324a82894be13e5de1665cb9af45dc5f869, and this change is dropped when the pinned libsqlite3-sys release contains it.
